Undergraduate Degrees

Tribhuvan University Affiliated Programs

Structured 4-year degree programs providing comprehensive theoretical knowledge and practical laboratory experience.

💻
TU / IOE

B.E. Computer Engineering

Covers Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Database Management, Microprocessors, and Cloud Infrastructure.

⏱️ 4 Years (8 Semesters) 🎓 Bachelor of Engineering
🏗️
TU / IOE

B.E. Civil Engineering

Specializes in Structural Analysis, Hydropower Engineering, Highway Construction, and Geotechnical Engineering.

⏱️ 4 Years (8 Semesters) 🎓 Bachelor of Engineering
⚡
TU / IOE

B.E. Electrical Engineering

Focuses on Power System Engineering, Renewable Energy Integration, High Voltage Automation, and Smart Grids.

⏱️ 4 Years (8 Semesters) 🎓 Bachelor of Engineering
📡
TU / IOE

B.E. Electronics & Communication

Covers Telecommunications, Embedded Systems, Internet of Things (IoT), Digital Signal Processing, and VLSI.

⏱️ 4 Years (8 Semesters) 🎓 Bachelor of Engineering
🚀
TU / FOHSS

Bachelor in Computer Application (BCA)

Comprehensive computer software degree covering Web Development, Mobile App Dev, Systems Analysis, and Cybersecurity.

⏱️ 4 Years (8 Semesters) 🎓 Bachelor Degree
Centers of Innovation

Research & Technical Infrastructure

State-of-the-art laboratories and research units driving student innovation.

AI Center

AI Research Center (AIRC)

Dedicated computer vision and natural language processing workstation focused on Nepali language AI applications.

Industry Link

CAILIC Collaborations

Center for Academia-Industry Linkages offering internships, industrial tours, and placement support.

Robotics Hub

Robotics & Embedded Systems Lab

Equipped with 3D printers, microcontrollers, sensors, and autonomous drone testing platforms.

Civil Testing

Material & Structural Testing Facility

ISO standard equipment for concrete testing, soil mechanics, and highway construction analysis.

Admission Process

Steps to Apply for Admissions

Follow our 4-step admission guide for TU B.E. and BCA programs.

01

IOE Entrance Exam

Appear and pass the Tribhuvan University IOE entrance examination.

02

Application Submission

Fill out the application online or visit the Balkhu admissions desk.

03

Merit Counseling

Attend merit counseling and verification of academic documents.

04

Enrollment

Complete fee payment, receive your student ID, and attend orientation.
